## Publication Information

**Date:** 1891

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i> (Christmas 1891) 657-660.

**Notes:** This article is signed ‘Esperanza’,  and was perhaps the work of Sister Florence of the Community of St. Michael and All Angels, Bloemfontein.
